_: The herald (news_chips.gd; Theme Hospital's announcer, Stronghold's scribe): one notice on screen at a time, the rest wait their turn in order instead of being written over, and the plain refusals get a dry voice. on: the switch (or --herald=on). queue: notices kept waiting at most (the oldest goes). min_read: seconds a notice stays before the next may take its place. voices: a notice that starts with 'starts' gets one of 'say' in place of that start (the rest of the line kept); 'whole' replaces the whole line.

say: A clerk whispers that it can't be done:

whole: That petitioner has already gone. The bench is still warm.
The petitioner left. Something about the wait.
Which town, Majesty? The map is right there.
A town first, Majesty. Any town. Click one.
The herald needs a town to shout at. Pick one on the map.

voices.starts: The doors of the court close
whole: The doors of the court close, and the realm moves again.
Court is done. The lords file out, the realm carries on.
The doors close. Somewhere a steward exhales.
The heralds run. The realm hears your will…
